lifecycle.activation_contract: Extension Manager removes the explicit OFF flag and appends --enable-prefix-caching only for an enabled MOD.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable the extension; the caller's --no-enable-prefix-caching baseline remains unchanged.

supported_workloads: requests whose repeated token prefix reaches at least one effective host cache page
out_of_scope: the Native Engine lease-safe bounded-LRU APC implementation

performance_claims.boundary: Experimental and workload-scoped; not Qwen3.5-35B, an accuracy result, a general claim, or official qualification.

performance_claims.repetitions: OFF/ON/OFF smoke bracket, 8 prompts per successful arm
performance_claims.eligibility_audit: 0/200 prompts can reuse a complete 2048-token aligned prefix page
performance_claims.boundary: Mechanism not exercised; no performance claim. The cold-first apparent gain is rejected by the trailing OFF arm.
